title: W118 Work-specific Task Register — Sandbox/GitHub Dual Closed Loops
model: W118 Work-level planning Task Register modeled on W70 DOC-093. It is not a runtime Core Task/Assignment database; Core :8000 is the sole runtime Task/Event authority.
rules: One canonical Work-level planning Task Register for W118; Sandbox is its operational project-planning authority.
This register tracks W118 implementation tasks and Work Package progress; it is not the runtime Core Task/Assignment/Event store.
Core :8000 is the sole canonical runtime Task/Assignment/Event authority; W102 owns Agent Loop policy; W12 owns execution/GitHub/CI bridge.
GitHub Issue mirror is generated from a normalized Core Task snapshot, not directly from this planning register.
execution_mode is a Work-level implementation authorization classification, not a runtime Agent Assignment state.
Owner-directed build tasks require owner_directive_ref; no Agent principal/ACK is fabricated.
Do not create a local Task database, dispatcher, event queue, event bus, execution host or CI engine in W118.

tasks.task_title: Task Register and separate Task/Assignment lifecycle
tasks.objective: Implement W118 Work-specific Task Register contract and transactional adapter with independent Task and Assignment state machines.
tasks.deliverable: Task Register schema/data and tested lifecycle adapter

acceptance_criteria.description: Task status uses PLANNED/READY/IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED/IN_REVIEW/DONE/CANCELLED.
Assignment status is a separate state machine and cannot be conflated with Task status.
DONE requires Assignment ACCEPTED and Owner evidence.

blockers: Runtime Task Register service adapter and durable deployment not yet connected.
tasks.next_action: Connect TaskRegistry transaction store to the canonical Sandbox Task Register without creating a second source of truth.
tasks.status_note: Separate Task/Assignment lifecycle code passes contract CI; runtime service integration remains pending.
tasks.scope_boundary: W118 Work-specific Task Register only; do not create a cross-Work task engine or mutate W70 schema.
tasks.verification_method: JSON schema validation, unit/contract tests, exact-SHA CI and Sandbox readback.
tasks.completion_rule: Canonical Sandbox Task Register and runtime adapter round-trip with no duplicate authority; all contract tests PASS.

tasks.objective: Mirror Sandbox Task to GitHub Issue and bind branch/commit/push/PR to exact Work, Task, Issue and SHA.
inputs: GitHub Issues and push payload contract
tasks.deliverable: Idempotent Issue adapter and exact source binding validator

acceptance_criteria.description: Issue mirror create/update/readback is idempotent and never assigns AI by GitHub Assignee.
Task branch and every commit carry the same Work/Task/Issue IDs.
Force push, missing SHA, malformed binding and legacy branch inference are rejected.

blockers: No live GitHub token/API mirror operation or task-scoped branch push has been executed.
tasks.next_action: Connect adapter to Sandbox Task Register with per-Task lock, then create/read back one controlled test Issue and push one task-scoped branch.
tasks.status_note: Contract code and tests exist; live GitHub API and task-specific branch runtime proof pending.
tasks.scope_boundary: GitHub Issue is a mirror; no merge, branch protection bypass, assignee mutation or Issue close without Owner acceptance.
tasks.verification_method: GitHub API readback, exact SHA push validation, idempotency and negative tests.
tasks.completion_rule: One real Task has one linked GitHub Issue and a task-scoped branch/commit/push verified at exact SHA.

tasks.objective: Receive authenticated GitHub events, deduplicate deliveries and reconcile push/CI evidence to the exact Sandbox Task.

acceptance_criteria.description: Webhook signature, repository, event allowlist and delivery UUID are verified.
Duplicate and replayed deliveries are idempotent; out-of-order CI is deferred.
CI PASS/FAIL records evidence only and never auto-accepts Task.

blockers: No HTTP route/worker deployed to Event Listener :8050; production webhook secret/TLS and durable DB are not configured.
tasks.next_action: Inspect existing Event Listener route surface and integrate inbox/reconciler without creating a new port or parallel event bus.
tasks.status_note: Authenticated inbox/reconciler contracts pass in-memory tests; production event path is not deployed.
tasks.scope_boundary: Reuse existing Event Listener and W52/W14 event/runtime owners; no new event bus or port.
tasks.verification_method: Signed webhook runtime test, replay/out-of-order tests, exact SHA reconciliation.
tasks.completion_rule: Real GitHub push and workflow_run callbacks reconcile to the correct Sandbox Task with no duplicate or false acceptance.
